title: CS1-SBRS: plateau collimation with a strided seed and backward blocks

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-SBRS algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, total charged sequential work is O(n^(13/4) 2^(2 sqrt n - n^(1/4))). All four resource bounds and source tolerance hold jointly for this one configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of the declared envelope is 1/2.

On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, the number Q of fresh source copies, including every discarded and rejected copy, is O(n^(3/2) 2^(sqrt n)). For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The same CS1-SBRS configuration in proof.md has fractional source tolerance epsilon(n) = 0. All acquired copies must be independent ideal coset states; the permitted malformed count is floor(0 Q) = 0. Under this promise it recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3. All four resource bounds hold jointly for this configuration on every branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, with absolute outside constants. No positive malformed fraction is claimed.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
